checks.detail: 6 required metrics covered across 6 sensitivity checks

sensitivity_checks.perturbation: Recompute headline and category metrics under strict citation faithfulness: any unsupported cited sentence sets citation_faithfulness and conclusion_support to 0.
sensitivity_checks.estimand_link: All category estimands with citation or conclusion metrics.
sensitivity_checks.decision_rule: If a qualitative conclusion changes sign or interval interpretation under strict support, report the claim as sensitivity-dependent.

sensitivity_checks.perturbation: Score false abstentions as answer errors and compare with a lenient policy that gives partial credit only on reviewed insufficiency or irreconcilable conflict items.
sensitivity_checks.estimand_link: Evidence insufficiency, cross-document contradiction, and temporal estimands.
sensitivity_checks.decision_rule: Claims about abstention quality require the same direction under strict and lenient policies.

sensitivity_checks.perturbation: Compare unweighted category macro averages with item-weighted overall averages and source-dataset stratified averages.
sensitivity_checks.decision_rule: Benchmark-level claims must disclose when category weighting changes model ordering or effect magnitude by more than the planned uncertainty interval.

sensitivity_checks.perturbation: Run headline contrasts on eligible external model baselines only, then separately on all diagnostic systems.
sensitivity_checks.estimand_link: System comparison estimands and reporting-card claims.
sensitivity_checks.decision_rule: Do not promote a model comparison claim if it appears only after adding diagnostic systems excluded by the reporting card.

sensitivity_checks.perturbation: Treat missing or non-merge-ready reviewed items as excluded in the primary analysis and as worst-case failures in a conservative bound.
sensitivity_checks.decision_rule: No category claim is allowed when worst-case missing-review bounds cross the null or contradict the primary direction.

sensitivity_checks.perturbation: Report unadjusted intervals plus family-level false-discovery or Holm-style sensitivity for the ten category hypotheses.
sensitivity_checks.estimand_link: All category hypotheses in the estimand registry.
sensitivity_checks.decision_rule: Treat claims that survive only unadjusted intervals as exploratory, not confirmatory.
